result.png.shows: Deformed cantilever mesh (displacements from the real good-fine job.frd, x20) coloured by nodal von Mises from the same .frd, allowable stress 166.7 MPa marked on the colour bar (spec_limits gate); tip deflection + wall stress vs mesh size with the +-2% band (convergence gate); reference-beam FEA/Euler-Bernoulli ratios with the +-3% band (verification gate).

loop.png.shows: Agent-loop replay (bad -> partly fixed -> good, gates failing per iteration, a replay of real grade JSONs) plus the 10-artifact x 3-gate self-test matrix; each red cell shows the measured value vs the limit from that mutant's real verdict JSON; script-enforced no-overlap check.

demo.mp4.shows: Linear-static load ramp of the real good-fine .frd displacement field (displacement scaled, labelled), full-load gate readouts, then each of the 9 mutants' failing gates with measured vs limit from its verdict JSON; overload-10x, undersized, propped-tip and load-on-ntip cards embed that mutant's own real deformed field.
